children: Angkor Resources Corp. (V.ANK) Hit a 52-Week High of 44 cents. In August, Angkor announced that a total of 2,800 meters of diamond drilling was planned for the Andong Bor copper-gold target in Cambodia and the first 1,099 meters was completed in mid July on the Thmei North target, a one-square-kilometer copper anomaly.

Banyan Gold Corp. (V.BYN) Hit a 52-Week High of $2.07. In August, Banyan Gold announced Tuesday that the first drillhole at the Seattle Creek zone on the greenfields Nitra Project, has confirmed a new high-grade gold and silver mineralized system 25 km west of the AurMac Deposit. Only the top 95 metres of the 600-metre hole have been assayed to date.

Cascadia Minerals Ltd. (V.CAM) Hit a 52-Week High of 46 cents. Last week, Cascadia announced drill results its Carmacks Gold project in Yukon. Hole CD-26-056 at Zone 2000S returned: 82.69 m of 1.12% copper with 0.64 g/t gold (1.78% CuEq), including 49.16 m of 1.63% copper with 0.95 g/t gold

CANEX Metals Inc (V.CANX) Hit a 52-Week High of 42 cents. Tuesday, CANEX announced that due to strong shareholder demand the Company has increased its previously announced non-brokered private placement and will now offer up to 21,428,571 common shares at a price of $0.35 per Common Share for proceeds of up to C$7.5 million.
CES Energy Solutions Corp (T. CEU) Hit a 52-Week High of $19.66. No news stories available today.

Carlin Gold Corporation (V.CGD) Hit a 52-Week High of $1.60. This week, Carlin reports the following changes to management, effective September 1. Dong Shim has been appointed Chief Financial Officer and Marla Ritchie, has been appointed Corporate Secretary. Aris Morfopoulos is resigning as Chief Financial Officer and Corporate Secretary effective August 31 to pursue other opportunities.

Copper Giant Resources Corp. (V.CGNT) Hit a 52-Week High of $1.44. Copper Giant announced its common shares have graduated from trading on the OTCQB Market to the OTCQX Best Market under the ticker symbol of "CGNRF". The Company's common shares will continue to trade on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol "CGNT".

Covalon Technologies Ltd (V.COV) Hit a 52-Week High of $3.49. Last week, Covalon reported Q3 revenue increased 20% year-over-year to $10 million, with all three sales channels contributing to growth. Adjusted EBITDA more than tripled to $3.0 million, reflecting efficient scaling with operating expenses up only 1%.

Cardiol Therapeutics Inc. (T.CRDL) Hit a 52-Week High of $3.17. Cardiol will participate in a Fireside Chat at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference in New York, on September 14 at 10:30 a.m. EDT.

Cenovus Energy Inc. (T.CVE) Hit a 52-Week High of $46.04. Cenovus is one of the biggest beneficiaries of favorable conditions in the oil sector. The company reported its best-ever quarterly financial performance for Q2. And in a major milestone, Cenovus is transitioning into one of the world's largest producers, producing more than one million barrels of oil equivalent per day.
Ecora Royalties PLC (T.ECOR) Hit a 52-Week High of $3.33. Ecora has announced that its registered office has changed with immediate effect, to a facility in London.
EDM Resources Inc (V.EDM) Hit a 52-Week High of 79 cents. No news stories available today.
Founders Metals Inc. (V.FDR) Hit a 52-Week High of $6.51. No news stories available today.
Mattr Corp (T.MATR) Hit a 52-Week High of $19.69. No news stories available today.
